title: Projections environment
description: How to make a checkout usable for the repository's toolchain extractors, as its CI does: `.github/projections/environment.json` or `.projections/environment.json`.

prepare.description: Run in order in a workspace before a toolchain extractor runs there, and in the working tree only on demand (`projections prepare`). They are repository code, so they need `--trust`.

toolchain.description: Commands whose output identifies the toolchain, such as `node --version`; part of the environment fingerprint that keys cached environmental extractions.

items.description: A program and its arguments, run directly, never through a shell.

strategy.description: The team's workspace strategy for this repository; a developer's `--workspace` or user configuration overrides it.

devcontainer.description: A devcontainer configuration describing the same environment. Reported by `projections doctor`; not run.

step.description: One command that makes a checkout usable, such as installing its dependencies.

id.description: Names the step in logs, records and failures.

run.description: A program and its arguments, run directly, never through a shell.

key.description: Globs (`*` within a path segment, `**` across them) of the files whose content decides whether the step must run again, typically lockfiles and manifests. The step reruns only when their paths or contents change.

directory.description: The working directory, relative to the checkout. Default `.`.

environment.description: Variables passed through from the invoking environment, besides the home, cache, temporary-directory and proxy variables every step receives. Steps may use the network.

timeoutMs.description: How long the step may run. Default ten minutes, at most an hour.
